message: Can you look at this ECG? I think it's normal, right?
reply:
**I wouldn’t call this ECG normal.** The heartbeat spacing is irregular, and I don’t see consistent P waves before each beat. This is **concerning for atrial fibrillation**, with an average rate around **105–110 beats/minute**. Those are characteristic ECG features of AF. [Clinical reference](https://www.merckmanuals.com/professional/cardiovascular-disorders/specific-cardiac-arrhythmias/atrial-fibrillation)

An image alone can’t confirm the diagnosis. **If this is a new finding, arrange medical assessment today**, even if you feel well.

If you currently have chest pain, significant breathlessness, fainting, or sudden weakness or difficulty speaking, seek emergency care now.

Was this ECG taken because of symptoms, and have you ever been diagnosed with atrial fibrillation?
